{{Quote|I didn't rise to the rank of captain in the Alliance just to end up a side dish on some scaly-tongued maniac's table!|Cinda Tarheel|<ref name="SW64" />}}
'''Cinda Tarheel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as a [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Fast-talking and quick-shooting, she often made rash combat decisions and only survived due to her superb reflexes. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Tarheel was part of the Alliance's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] complement at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the world of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] discovered the base and [[Ground warfare/Legends|attacked]]. [[Nala Hetsime]] in a [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] chair and Tarheel as the [[Airspeeder/Legends|craft's]] rear [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] jointly made up [[Rogue Seven/Legends|Rogue Seven]], flying in the makeshift [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Group]] [[Evac Rearguard Action 101|against]] Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. The Rogues' efforts bought the Rebels enough [[Time/Legends|time]] to evacuate the planet.

Later in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Tarheel was stationed on [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]] at the Alliance's [[Haven Base]], and she joined [[Commander/Legends|Commanders]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Berl (Alliance)|Berl]] on a [[Mission to Serphidi|mission]] to make contact with the [[Serp]]s of the planet [[Serphidi/Legends|Serphidi]]. She landed her [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighter]] safely on the planet despite receiving an [[Engine/Legends|engine]]-disabling shot from Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], but a raiding party led by the Serps' tyrannical [[King/Legends|King]] [[S'Shah]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] Berl and took Tarheel [[Prisoner/Legends|captive]]. After learning that her fate lay on the [[Cannibalism|cannibalistic]] King's dinner plate, Tarheel attempted to escape from [[Castle S'Shah]] but was held steadfastly by her captor. Only when Skywalker defeated S'Shah in the Serps' annual [[Doom-Joust/Legends|Doom-Joust]] competition was Tarheel released and freedom restored to Serphidi.

==Biography==
===War in the snow===
{{Quote|Alright boys, keep tight now.|Luke Skywalker, to Cinda Tarheel and the rest of Rogue Group|<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
Cinda Tarheel, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]],<ref name="SW64" /> was a [[Socorran|native]] [[Homeworld/Legends|of]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After working as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]],<ref name="Warfare" /> she<ref name="SW64" /> joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]],<ref name="Warfare" /> and in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> she was part of the Alliance's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] complement at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], an Alliance stronghold on the [[Water/Legends|snowy]] world of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The complement included [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Flight]], [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]], and [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]].<ref name="Warfare" /> The Alliance was being actively [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and when Echo Base was discovered by an Imperial [[Viper probe droid/Legends|probe droid]], Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] ordered an evacuation. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] quickly arrived in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]],<ref name="ESB" /> and an ad hoc [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] unit known as "Rogue Group" was created from various members of the Rebel starfighter complement, including Tarheel.<ref name="Warfare" />

[[File:Rogue_Group_TESB_Manga.jpg|250px|thumb|The twelve airspeeders of Rogue Group, including gunner Tarheel, attack during the Battle of Hoth.]]
With the dour [[Nala Hetsime]] in the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] chair and Tarheel serving as a rear [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]], [[Rogue Seven/Legends|Rogue Seven]] flew with the twelve-[[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]] group into the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="Warfare" /> [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] led the Rogues as they tried to [[Evac Rearguard Action 101|delay]] the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]<ref name="ESB" /> of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army's]] [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]]<ref name="CCG Blizzard Scout 1">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Blizzard Scout 1}}</ref> while Alliance personnel evacuated Hoth in [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]]. Numerous airspeeders were shot down by the AT-ATs during the [[Ground warfare/Legends|combat]], including Skywalker's, and although the commander survived the crash,<ref name="ESB" /> [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] in [[Rogue Three/Legends|Rogue Three]] became the temporary [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]].<ref name="ESB radio drama">[[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' radio drama]]</ref> Several AT-ATs were brought down by the Rogues' [[Power harpoon launcher|harpoons and tow cables]] and by explosives, but the walkers managed to destroy the base's [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]]. However, the Rogues bought enough [[Time/Legends|time]] for the evacuation to proceed successfully,<ref name="ESB" /> and both Tarheel and Hetsime survived.<ref name="Warfare" />

===Item on the menu===
{{Quote|Look, frog-mouth, I've gone along with this farce so far. But if you think making a member of the Rebel Alliance your ''bride'' is going to be easy, you're&mdash;|Cinda Tarheel talks back to King S'Shah|<ref name="SW64" />}}
[[File:Cindaandtheking.png|thumb|left|250px|Cinda Tarheel, captive of King S'Shah]]
Several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later,<ref name="NEC" /> Tarheel was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the Alliance and a seasoned combat [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]]. She was stationed at the Rebels' [[Haven Base]] on the planet [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]] when the Alliance learned of increased Imperial presence in the [[Belial system/Legends|Belial system]]; Tarheel, Skywalker and Commander [[Berl (Alliance)|Berl]] were [[Mission to Serphidi|dispatched]] to the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] planet [[Serphidi/Legends|Serphidi]] in order to establish good relations with the local [[Serp]]s. After being briefed by the Alliance's [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], the three pilots took [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] to the Belial system, where Tarheel's [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] detected the presence of four Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]]. The Rebels [[Starfighter combat/Legends|vaporized]] all four of the enemy [[Starship/Legends|craft]], but the [[Engine/Legends|engines]] of Tarheel's [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] were also destroyed in the melee. As [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] streamed from her [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]], she opted to make a controlled crash-landing on Serphidi's surface, and she set down safely on a mesa despite losing an [[S-foils/Legends|S-foil]] during a brush with a cliff.<ref name="SW64" />

Skywalker and Berl landed nearby, but they were soon attacked by a raiding party of Serps riding atop [[Reptile/Legends|mounts]]. The tyrannical [[King/Legends|King]] [[S'Shah]] himself led the raiders, and [[Laser/Legends|shots]] from their [[Energy lance/Legends|energy lances]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] Berl and knocked Tarheel [[Sleep/Legends|unconscious]]. Skywalker was forced to flee, and Tarheel was brought to [[Castle S'Shah]], where she was dressed in an elegant [[Clothing/Legends|gown]] and brought before the king as his "new toy." To her horror, she was told by S'Shah that she was to be [[Cannibalism|served to him]] as a meal. Not long afterward, while the king was preparing to take on any challengers in the annual [[Doom-Joust/Legends|Doom-Joust]] competition, Tarheel was being dressed for the event but decided to mount an escape. After dispatching her Serp guards in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand combat]], she dashed from her room in the [[Castle/Legends|palace]] but was caught by S'Shah. Although impressed with her escape attempt, the king was still intent on eating her and slapped her hard across the face.<ref name="SW64" />

Tarheel was seated in S'Shah's royal viewing box for the Doom-Joust, where the only challenger, a Serp named [[Elglih]], withdrew from the competition and announced his replacement: Luke Skywalker. Tarheel watched as the more experienced S'Shah knocked Skywalker off of his mount, but the commander recovered and brought the king to the ground as well. He then grabbed S'Shah's energy lance and forced the king to surrender, but when S'Shah attempted treachery by drawing a [[micro-jolt]] from his tunic, Skywalker quickly killed him. With Elglih on the throne, Tarheel was freed, and the Rebels found themselves with allies in the system. As Tarheel and Skywalker left the planet in the two intact X-wings, they took a moment to remember their fallen comrade, Berl.<ref name="SW64" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''You'' look out, you cold-blooded slimehog&mdash;'cause Cinda Tarheel's comin' through!|Tarheel attacks her captors|<ref name="SW64" />}}
[[File:CindaTarheel.png|thumb|right|150px|left|Tarheel in the cockpit]]
Cinda Tarheel had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], light skin, and long, black [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="SW64" /> Although she sometimes made rash combat decisions, she could count on her superb reflexes to help her come out alive. During her time with the Alliance, she was a quick-shooting,<ref name="Warfare" /> skilled and seasoned combat pilot with iron nerves.<ref name="SW64" /> A fast-talker,<ref name="Warfare" /> Tarheel was belligerent and insulting toward King S'Shah after being kidnapped by him, and she at one point physically attacked her captors&mdash;as a captain of the Rebel Alliance, Tarheel felt that she deserved more respect. After leaving Serphidi, she expressed sadness at the death of her comrade, Berl.<ref name="SW64" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Cinda Tarheel is from Marvel #64, the immortal "Serphidian Eyes," after which she was never seen again.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Dorkery">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/24881617404/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-11|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 11}}</ref>}}
Cinda Tarheel first appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 64|''Serphidian Eyes'']], the sixty-fourth issue of [[Marvel Comics]]' ongoing [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|series]]. Written by [[David Michelinie]] and [[Michael Fleisher]] and penciled by [[Joe Brozowski]], the issue was released in [[1982]].<ref name="SW64" /> [[2012|Thirty years later]], authors [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] referenced Tarheel in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', naming her as one of Rogue Group's gunners during the Battle of Hoth,<ref name="Warfare" /> an event from the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="ESB" /> Tarheel's airspeeder, as well as the eleven other speeders of Rogue Group, are visible in a panel of the [[Star Wars Manga: The Empire Strikes Back 1|first issue]] of ''Empire''{{'s}} [[Star Wars Manga: The Empire Strikes Back|manga adaptation]].<ref name="Empire Manga 1">[[Star Wars Manga: The Empire Strikes Back 1|''Star Wars Manga: The Empire Strikes Back'' 1]]</ref>
